title: docs(automation): flows.mdx names every path and not-judged case of the unknown notify channel refusal
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUZKdq3PK2Sab53cT3

Follow-up from #32733 (PR #33970, review-c verdict 6896677521). Docs only. Grade and state are left to triage's first touch.

## 维护者速读

- 现象：流程文档 `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx` 讲"通知节点引用未知渠道会被拒绝保存"时，只写了 `nodes.N.config.channels` 一条路径和一种不判定的情形。
- 实际行为：保存时还会判定列表成员和区域正文中的渠道路径；以下情形一律不判定、照常保存：内核尚未就绪（kernel:ready 之前）的保存；渠道清单读不出来（包括 PR #33970 新增的：清单里有不是 `{ id: string }` 的成员）。
- 影响：作者和 AI 读文档时无法预判哪些写法会被拒绝。

## Expected

`flows.mdx` names every path the refusal judges (the same paths the semantic entry `18.notify-channel-unknown-refused` reason text names after PR #33970) and every not-judged case: a save before `kernel:ready`, no channel reader, and an unreadable roster (including a member that is not `{ id: string }`). Words only; no behaviour change.

## Seam

`content/docs/automation/flows.mdx` (notify node section); source of truth `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts` `refuseUnknownNotifyChannels` and `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.notify-channel-unknown-refused.ts` on main after PR #33970.

Dedupe words: `flows.mdx notify unknown channel not judged`, `notify channel refusal paths docs`.
